decisions.reason: This app is very close to the firm's existing dental software and workflow knowledge, so management is likely to see strong absorptive capacity and good scope to improve it through customer feedback and integration.

The training institute fits the firm's dental customer base and domain expertise, but as a service business it is somewhat less central to its core software capabilities, making it worth keeping but with more caution.

A remote screen-sharing support tool draws on technical know-how but is relatively generic and less tied to the firm's distinctive knowledge base, so management is more likely to redeploy resources elsewhere if early traction is limited.
